payload.prompt:
Create a Europa Universalis V victory reward tree background DDS asset.
Subject: Create a wide, route-specific victory reward tree background for Scientific Victory.
A clean, modern mood in azure and cool white: first and foremost a real tree, with natural bark, organic knots, and irregular branching, only subtly touched by its theme through a faint luminous glow tracing the grain of the bark and a few small crystalline accents, set against a hazy field of observatory machinery. The trunk enters at the upper-right corner and sweeps diagonally across nearly the whole frame toward the lower-left, branching naturally left and right along the way to command most of the picture. Precise, exploratory, forward-looking, but recognizably a living tree, not a machine or circuit diagram.

Shared production rules:
A beautiful, high-quality 16:9 painting or photograph of a single tree standing close to the viewer, large enough to dominate the frame and partly block a hazy, distant landscape beyond it — near and far are the same place under the same light, not a collage. Let the tree feel bigger than the picture: at the edge named below, a branch or the trunk simply runs off the frame, as though only part of a larger tree was caught in view, so no roots or ground appear there. Each route below names one exact entry point on one border and one direction the tree grows toward on the far side of the frame — anchor the trunk at that exact point (don't default to the generic 'trunk rooted in the bottom-left corner' shot unless that is the named point) and let it sweep across the frame toward the named direction, its branches spreading out along the way so the tree commands most of the picture. The six routes should read as differently angled at a glance because their entry points and directions differ, not because the tree is boxed into a smaller region. Let the trunk fork naturally into a handful of branches as it grows, each with some open, unembellished stretches of bark — a round button will be overlaid on the branches later, so avoid drawing circles, rings, or icons, but otherwise trust your own eye for where and how the branches should fall. Prioritize a gorgeous, atmospheric, painterly result over any rigid structure. No text or UI elements.
Reference image: retain only this route's identity motifs and restrained color language from the uploaded icon. The requested full-scene art medium and tree composition take precedence; do not turn this wide asset into an icon or copy the reference composition.
Distinctiveness: keep the result in the same visual family as the reference, but make it visibly different at a glance through changed shape language, object arrangement, cropping, or decorative accents.
Composition: follow the explicit edge-starting tree direction, trunk, branch topology, and clear waypoint zones in the subject. This is a full UI background, not a centered icon.
Target format: final DDS target is exactly 2048x1152 and must stay under 1,200,000 bytes.

Style rules:
Match the palette, brush feel, lighting, icon density, and framing discipline of the selected target's reference image. Keep the final subject and asset meaning driven by the selected batch entry, not the reference subject.

Use the reference only as a style guide. Keep the result in the same visual family, but make it visibly distinct at a glance by changing the silhouette, crop, object arrangement, and ornament placement. Do not mirror the reference composition or reuse its exact outline.
Avoid:
text, letters, numbers, labels, UI buttons, circular nodes or rings, badges, medallions, icons on the tree, logos, watermark, flat 2D illustration, cutout foreground pasted over a backdrop, mismatched lighting between tree and background, visible roots or ground line at the cropped edge, whole tree fully contained in frame, second tree, trunk entering from a different border than the one specified, tree cropped small into one corner instead of sweeping across most of the frame
